title: One fiscal year of Panabo City's budget and actual amounts
description: From the Commission on Audit's Annual Audit Report: Statement of Comparison of Budget and Actual Amounts (SCBAA). One file per year in src/Data/Budget/years/; the site picks up new files automatically. See README.md.

amount.description: Pesos as a plain number (no commas or ₱). Negative amounts are written with a minus sign, not parentheses.

final.description: Budgeted amount, final (after supplemental budgets and realignments).

source.description: The document these figures come from. Shown on the page.

sourceFile.description: The file they were extracted from, for your records.

sourceDocument.description: The original report file for the page's "Download the original report" link: a path inside src/Data/Audit/reports/, e.g. "2024/09-PanaboCity2024_Part1-FS.pdf". Leave it out to hide the link.

totals.description: Totals exactly as printed in the report. The site checks that the lines below add up to these and warns in the browser console if they don't.

currentAppropriations.description: Total Current Appropriations: this year's budget.

continuingAppropriations.description: Total Continuing Appropriations: unspent budgets carried over from earlier years.

revenue.description: Revenue lines, e.g. Local Sources › Tax Revenue › Tax Revenue - Property.

category.description: Local Sources, External Sources, or Receipts from Borrowings.

group.description: Optional middle level, e.g. Tax Revenue, Non-Tax Revenue.

expenditures.description: Spending lines by sector, e.g. General Public Services › Personnel Services.

appropriation.description: "current": this year's budget. "continuing": budgets carried over from earlier years.

sector.description: e.g. General Public Services, Education, Economic Services, Other Purposes.

group.description: Optional middle level under Other Purposes, e.g. Debt Service, LDRRMF, 20% Development Fund, Others.

item.description: e.g. Personnel Services, Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses, Capital Outlay, Aid to Barangays.
